spec_match.rationale: Composes the exact add(sequence<USVString>) argument, mirrors Chromium's IsValidPath rules verbatim (leading '/', no '//', non-empty, not an absolute URL), derives ManifestId per the spec's id-falls-back-to-start_url-sans-fragment rule, and shows the real per-prompt/total quotas.

interactive.rationale: Editable rows, two use-case presets from the explainer (office suite, streaming portal), live payload and manifest previews, per-path validation verdicts that update on input, a genuine subApps.add() invocation, and a copy action with an honest clipboard fallback.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index promises compose + pre-check + real call + copyable code; all four are on the page.

edge_cases.rationale: Invalid path shapes (absolute URL, missing slash, scheme-relative, empty), over-20 batches flagged as wholesale QuotaExceededError, ManifestId fragment stripping, and clipboard denial are all handled and were exercised.

references.rationale: Links the chromestatus entry plus the spec anchors for add() and SubAppsAddResponse.

conformance.rationale: Covered by the feature suite: exposure gating scripts run here, and the add()-resolves-to-records and quota contracts are recorded as manual IWA-only assertions rather than fake passes.

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP drive: preset swap updated the payload to /apps/* and announced it, typing an absolute URL flipped that row's verdict to the TypeError warning, adding a row updated the quota line, the real call threw TypeError with the composed payload echoed, and the clipboard fallback printed the snippet; zero console errors, both viewports overflow-free.

telemetry_health.rationale: subapps-playground-real-add only fires with the API present; the hosted-tab branch reports subapps-playground-fallback-surfaced checking the genuine TypeError, so fallback is never a pass.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables throughout; the secondary Remove/Copy buttons override background AND color together (ivory on black-border with text-black); path-error text uses accent-rose on paper which meets AA for the bold 0.85rem size.

accessibility.rationale: Every input has a visible label plus per-row aria-label, path verdicts are tied to their inputs via aria-describedby, row Remove buttons have indexed aria-labels, quota and status lines are polite live regions, and all controls are native with focus-visible outlines.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Rows collapse to a single column under 640px with full-width 2.75rem-min controls; 0px horizontal overflow measured at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800; payload/manifest pres scroll internally.

openQuestions.title: Extend the manifest composer with OS-integration fields
openQuestions.detail: The generated manifest covers name/id/start_url/display/icons/launch_handler. Adding optional protocol_handlers and file_handlers rows would let visitors compose the OS-integration surfaces the explainer highlights, and preview the per-sub-app handler behavior described in Internal Manifest Data.

openQuestions.title: Validate scope interplay between composed rows
openQuestions.detail: The playground validates each path shape but does not cross-check composed rows for the scope-prefix ConstraintError the way the Lifecycle Walkthrough's checker does; wiring that checker across all rows here would predict per-row failedApps entries before the real call.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive form control panel layout without horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Label every field, keep touch targets comfortable, and validate with messages tied to the field they describe.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Visible labels plus aria-describedby per-path verdict notes under each input; min-height 2.75rem on all inputs and buttons.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive form control panel layout without horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Grid rows with minmax(0)/full-width collapse on narrow viewports; wide code blocks scroll in their own container.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Row grid collapses to one column under 640px; payload/manifest/result pres use overflow:auto; 0px overflow verified at 360px.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region status updates aria-live button action result
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce async action outcomes through a polite live region rather than visual change alone.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Quota line and status output are aria-live polite and announce preset loads, row changes, call outcomes, and the clipboard fallback.

summary: Manifest/argument playground for subApps.add() with Chromium-exact path pre-checks, honest quota messaging, a genuine call, and IWA-ready copyable code. CDP-verified end to end in headless Chromium (both viewport classes, all controls, real TypeError surfaced, clipboard-denied fallback exercised, zero console errors besides the environment-blocked font stylesheet).
